letterClaims.text: In the 2025 Riverside Apartment Series for Example Interior Photographer, I matched colour across adjoining rooms with mixed window and ceiling light. I used the photographer’s reference frame and local white-balance masks, and the photographer accepted the set after one review round.

As a self-employed freelance photo editor, I have edited residential interiors in Lightroom from photographers’ files and colour-reference notes. I corrected white balance and vertical alignment without removing permanent room features, then delivered named image sets in the requested dimensions and checked them against the photographer’s shot list.
I welcome the opportunity to discuss my interior-editing work and portfolio.
